mcq_drop.why: tautological assertion-reason (R restates A); oddly worded

patterns: PYQs ask chairman-body one-liners: Veerappa Moily = Administrative Reforms; NCRWC (2000) = M.N. Venkatachaliah.
Statement items on NCRWC nature (recommendatory, set up by Cabinet resolution not Parliament) are the trap shape.
Expect State-appointed vs Centre-appointed traps (Rajamannar/Kurian Joseph vs Sarkaria/Punchhi).
App MCQs add 2nd ARC report numbers and communal-inquiry commissions; mostly sound but some A-R items pair unrelated facts.
